why.title: Why work with Chasity
why.intro: Insurance is personal. You get one person who listens first, explains plainly, and stays with you after you sign.

items.title: Personalized plans
items.text: Coverage built around your budget, your health, and your family — not a script.

items.title: Multiple carrier options
items.text: Access to several insurance companies so you can compare real choices side by side.

items.title: Real benefits experience
items.text: Background as a Chicago Public Schools benefit enrollment counselor and a benefits specialist.

items.title: Small-business know-how
items.text: Help with startup setup, hiring, systems, and employee benefits — all from the same trusted contact.

signup.title: Join the LuvUrCity community
signup.text: Monthly coverage tips, enrollment reminders, and small-business resources. No spam. Unsubscribe anytime.

booking.title: Book your free consultation
booking.text: Pick a time that works for you. Calls take about 30 minutes, cost nothing, and come with no obligation to buy.

hero.headline: Your Health. Your Family. Your Future.
hero.subhead: Straight answers on health, life, and income protection from a licensed agent who has helped Chicago families and businesses since 2009 — plus hands-on support for small-business owners.
